bends.reason: B1 is the end tab on the bottom short end of the B3-B4 strip. In the raw TOP view it shows edge-on as a short bar at the bottom-left end of the upright strip, pointing away from the main plate. In the SIDE views it shows edge-on along the strip's short end, and in the FRONT views it shows face-on, with holes, beside the upright. In the section, both scan surfaces trace the blue, roughly 15 mm, 90 deg leg, and no points lie on the orange.

They also sit on the 30 mm parent strip up to the B6 window flange and on the main plate beyond the window. No points lie on the orange. The edge flange shows edge-on along the B2 edge in the TOP and SIDE views.
